path_surface_coverage.evidence: HTTP route input/output -> planner -> signed attestor -> adapter transaction -> tenant_migrations authoritative plan_payload -> source row/quarantine -> rollback/readback, schema upgrade/readback, CLI check/dry-run/apply, Cloudflare worker configuration/route/body/error paths, Story/Spec/Architecture/Runbook, verification artifacts and GitHub contract checks were all inspected. Quarantine and collection_state retain partial/unknown outcomes; legacy NULL audit rows fail closed rather than being silently backfilled.

judgment_delta.judgment: MigrationPlanAttestor signs canonical dry_run payloads with EdDSA/digest and verify rejects tamper, wrong key, digest, signature, mode or candidate target. Route/planner/adapter revalidate target candidates; rollback reads authoritative applied_rows from the tenant-scoped applied ledger rather than trusting a caller plan. Focused tests cover tamper, cross-tenant and rollback paths.

migrations:apply and migrations:rollback require tenant_migration:apply / tenant_migration:rollback, verified service subject actor, approved=true, non-empty approval_id and reason. The ledger persists plan_digest, plan_payload, approved_by, approval_id, approval_reason and approved_at; adapter and schema fail closed on missing columns, constraints or legacy NULL audit rows.
